commentaries.author: Parimelazhagar
commentaries.text:
Her friend says she knows his reassuring words and his goodness, so he won’t be long. She answers.

I keep his words in my mind, and all I speak of is his goodness. Yet pallor has come, and this is treachery. The body follows mind and speech, so it shouldn’t have come there either. She says this to show that she is bearing up.
